title: Why one template
lead: The build cost grows with the number of route files, not with the number of pages.

blocks.text: Every route file is compiled and type-checked on its own, with everything it imports. One template serves every page of every collection, so a new page adds data, not compile time.
300 pages as separate files: 1252 s. The same 300 pages through one template: 98 s.
